parameters.name: output_GMT_seconds
parameters.meaning: GMT seconds since midnight 14 October 1582, excluding leap seconds

semantics.failureOutputs: Both numeric outputs are zero when GMT is unavailable.
semantics.feedback: Preserve the documented feedback condition; do not invent a zero-filled successful token.

parameters.name: input_seconds
parameters.meaning: Seconds since midnight 14 October 1582, excluding leap seconds

parameters.name: picture_string
parameters.representation: VSTRING: halfword binary length followed by picture characters

semantics.blankPicture: Uses the Language Environment COUNTRY runtime option; no locale is inferred by this profile.
semantics.failureOutput: Invalid input produces blank output and non-CEE000 feedback.
semantics.picture: Implement the documented picture language. The caller's supplied picture is authoritative.

parameters.name: input_char_date
parameters.representation: VSTRING: halfword binary length followed by 5 to 255 date characters

parameters.name: picture_string
parameters.representation: VSTRING: halfword binary length followed by picture characters

semantics.calendar: Gregorian; valid dates are 15 October 1582 through 31 December 9999.
semantics.failureOutput: An invalid input date produces zero Lilian days and non-CEE000 feedback.
semantics.picture: Preserve the supplied picture language and documented leading/trailing character handling.
semantics.centuryWindow: Two-digit years depend on the runtime century window, configurable through CEESCEN. Do not silently substitute a target date library's default window.
semantics.compilerContext: COBOL intrinsic date arithmetic requires the original INTDATE setting; this profile does not infer it.

parameters.name: output_seconds
parameters.meaning: Local seconds since midnight 14 October 1582, excluding leap seconds

semantics.timeZone: Runtime-local time; the original deployment time zone must be supplied rather than inferred as UTC.
semantics.failureOutputs: Unavailable local time produces zero numeric outputs and non-CEE000 feedback; no successful character timestamp is fabricated.
semantics.outputConsistency: The day count, seconds and formatted timestamp represent the same local date/time.
